attributes.scope: TOOL lane (owns tools/gdl + memory_graph surfaces): run-36 amendment queue, one commit per item BEFORE the next, and REPRODUCE EACH ITEM'S SYMPTOM with one command before coding (new dispatch screen - a run-36 item's symptom had vanished and masked a 15x-larger defect). (1) probe --revert --whole-file: stamp the snapshot's anchor commit and REFUSE to restore when it predates HEAD (UA: it nearly destroyed a committed exact; defake_gate baseline already stamps - copy that). (2) wf_rederive_pin: build its raw-body input itself (or verify freshness) instead of reading whatever object is on disk (PC run-36 law: it pasted a reverted probe's hash). (3) unabsorbed.py: read the raw .postprocess/body object and give rule-served functions their OWN class (claim.law.MC_the-unabsorbed-census-scores-the-postprocessed-object... - the census premise was 24:1 wrong). (4) refusal records must enumerate WHICH verifiers ran (MC: a cap read as 'path closed' but never ran value_equality_recolor - proposal-gate a verifiers_run list on postprocessor refusals). (5) brief/context: surface pin-mechanism sentences that NAME a function in the TU roster, and stop truncating mechanism prose at ~600 chars (UA: the operative sentence sat past the cut and outvalued every graph query). (6) NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL is decisive at ONE: object bytes unchanged = the axis never reached codegen; fire the re-plan banner on the FIRST, not the third (UA/UB measured 2 wasted probes each). (7) probe --revert verdict wording: a reverted state must not print NEUTRAL-REARRANGED/NEUTRAL-WORSE as if the revert failed (UB/MC both burned verification calls); also suppress the 12 scaffold-census lines per probe behind --verbose. (8) derived frame metrics assert their floors (CH: 'param area 0' is below the EABI minimum 8 and shipped into a law; add the assert to ci_paramarea_probe.py and any tool deriving frame figures). (9) region-untouched claims state the addressing modes covered (CH: two measurements in one lineage were both blind to register-relative cursor stores; proposal-gate an addressing_modes_covered field when a claim asserts a region is never accessed). (10) propose-record tu: error - say the module path needs its .c suffix (UB burned a round trip). (11) extern-size census: ~20-line tool cross-checking every extern T name[N] against symbols.txt sizes (UB found one by hand and it was score-decisive); promote under composed_census and run it image-wide, report rows - do NOT edit source (RS lane owns fixes). Scoped tests between items, FULL suites at each commit; ninja 'main.dol: OK' at close; expected verdict changes stated per item; parallel fleets please pick other TUs
